name: pi5_3a_weak_psu
description: Same, but a 3 A PSU without usb_max_current_enable: Pi 5 USB limit 0.6 A (power_model budget). The outcome hinges on how much of the TX-burst current the port limiter reacts to (usb.pi5_trip_tx_weight, UNMEASURED; --set usb.pi5_trip_tx_weight=1 gives the worst case 'every TX burst trips it', D12).
